comments.content: The function `buildReLocationTemplate()` is referenced but not defined in the repository. This will lead to a compilation error. Ensure the function is implemented or correctly imported from its package.

The `ReLocateComment` tests assume that `mockLLMClient.CompletionsWithCtx` will not return `nil` for `response`, which might lead to nil dereference errors in case of mock changes or unexpected nil returns. Consider adding nil checks or default non-nil initialization conditions to prevent potential null pointer exceptions.

summary.walkthrough: This pull request introduces a new feature for handling comment relocation when deterministic positioning fails. It adds a new LLM-based fallback mechanism to regenerate code snippets for comments that cannot be positioned using existing methods.

change_groups.title: Add LLM-based comment relocation feature
change_groups.summary: This group of changes introduces a new function `buildReLocationTemplate` to load LLM conversation templates for comment relocation. It modifies the review command to include this new template and updates the loop execution to use LLM for regenerating code snippets when deterministic positioning fails. Tests are added to ensure the new functionality works as expected.

change_groups.title: Implement directory summarization and manifest indexing
change_groups.summary: This set of changes adds functionality to summarize directories and index manifest files. It introduces new functions to group files by directory and summarize them using LLM, as well as to parse and store package manifests. Tests are included to verify the correct behavior of these new indexing features.

summary.testing_notes: To test these changes, run the review command with a repository containing comments that fail deterministic positioning. Verify that the LLM-based relocation is attempted and that comments are correctly repositioned. Additionally, test the indexing process on a repository with various directories and manifest files to ensure summaries and package data are correctly generated and stored.
summary.risk: medium: The changes introduce new LLM-based logic and indexing features that could affect existing workflows if not properly handled.
